facts.value: Board P Q6 (phase-9 draft, dec-p-stusb-local-clamp): VBUS_EN_SNK cascode with source on VBEN_PIN (U1.16, D11 clamp), drain on VBEN (R12 to the Q1 gate network) and gate on VG_LOC = VDD_LOC / 2 (R31/R32 100k); the open-drain pin cannot rise above the gate, so it stays at or below about 10.5 V
facts.conditions: VGS stays below the 20 V row (at most 10.50 V with VDD_LOC at its 20.794 V surge-row bound and 1 % divider resistors); the minimum gate drive at a 5 V attach (2.165 V at the idle IDD maximum, 2.083 V at twice the idle typical) exceeds the 1.5 V VGS(th) maximum row (VDS = VGS, 250 uA, 25 C only). RDS(on) at that drive and off-state leakage at temperature, which set the asserted VBEN level and Q1 off-state integrity, are not in this bundle (UNSOURCED). Behaviour unmeasured.
